title: The existing intrinsic evaluation and its normalized comparison data
statement: For an inverse coefficient system and n, levelTower is actual evaluation at n followed by the constant strict diagram, and E is its exact localization. Retain the existing normalized ordinary and derived inverse-image, direct-image and open-extension comparisons, with their proved isomorphism properties. No coefficient lift is chosen. The compatibility of gamma with these comparisons remains the separate existing theorem gamma_evaluation.

source.place: Zheng, section 4.1 and 4.10; Stacks Project, Tags 015F and 0F7B: exact evaluation and adjunction mate comparisons.

proof.text: Retain the actual existing construction and section normalization. Its exactness and specified adjunction comparisons are the existing proofs from the listed dependencies; this refactoring changes only file ownership. The remaining gamma compatibility theorem is not used in the construction.

from.place: The maps used here are tensor reassociation, evaluation, and adjunction units and counits: intrinsic proper/open mate and pasting argument (parent step 2); The coefficient-comparison constructions already used in the intrinsic mate-pasting module, factored to satisfy the compile limit.
